title: G0W0 Si k888 (database-aligned), SG15 3s3p2d, five-stage pipeline
note: Database-aligned Si G0W0. SCF screening grid must be the archived 8x8x8 (512 q-points, KPT_scf identical to si-paper-all_kpath), because LibRPA builds chi0 on the SCF grid; the earlier 4x4x4 demo never reproduced the screening. ABACUS symmetry -1 in SCF and NSCF, SG15 PP + 3s3p2d NAO + pca1e-6 ABFS with hashes identical to the database Si-SG15 set, nbands 44, ecutwfc 120. LibRPA runs the archived definition: nfreq 16, minimax, n_params_anacon -1, cut-Coulomb EXX (use_fullcoul_exx f, the binary default), LU Wc solve (use_cholesky_gw_wc f, the binary default), head/wing computed internally - pyatb_librpa_df/ is moved aside because this binary reads it unconditionally when present, and that PyATB head (21.24) is not the internal head (14.66). The band path is truncated to Gamma -> 0.85(Gamma-X) where the Si CBM lies; the database si-paper-all_kpath gap is 1.0596 eV on the same segment. ACCEPTANCE IS JUDGED ON THE RENDERED KS/EXX/GW BAND FIGURE (band_structure.png) together with the reference-free band gates, not on an exact gap match: the gap delta against 1.0596 eV is ADVISORY within a 2 eV gross limit, because a database record may use a different EXX Coulomb definition or path sampling while its band shape is still the right answer. See oml_mcp/band_analysis.ACCEPTANCE_RULE, oml_mcp/band_figure.py and docs/guide/controlled-execution.md.
